items.source: Configuration parsers may provide the ability to attach source metadata during the parse phase. They will offer this metadata in a generic format which can be further modified by a SourceExtractor before being attached to the bean definition metadata.
items.translation: 配置解析器可能提供在解析阶段附加源元数据的功能。它们将以通用格式提供此元数据，该元数据在附加到 Bean 定义元数据之前，可由 SourceExtractor 进一步修改。

items.source:
Extract the source metadata from the candidate object supplied
by the configuration parser.
items.translation: 从配置解析器提供的候选对象中提取源元数据。
sourceCandidate - 原始源元数据（永远不为 null）

items.source: definingResource - the resource that defines the given source object (may be null)
items.translation: definingResource - 定义给定源对象的资源（可能为 null）

items.source: the source metadata object to store (may be null)
items.translation: 要存储的源元数据对象（可为null）

items.source: This is a functional interface and can therefore be used as the assignment target for a lambda expression or method reference.
items.translation: 这是一个功能接口，因此可用作 Lambda 表达式或方法引用的赋值目标。
